abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the effects of intramuscular injections with testosterone (Sustanon) on sex-hormone levels, sexual functioning and general well-being in patients treated with orchidectomy for bilateral testicular cancer. PATIENTS AND METHODS: The study comprised seven men (median age 38 years, range 25-46) who had undergone orchidectomy for bilateral testicular cancer. Patients received intramuscular injections with testosterone every 3 weeks and blood samples for hormone analysis were collected from each patient at three times: one day after testosterone injection (t1), halfway between subsequent injections (t2) and just before injection (t3). Plasma hormone levels were then related to sexual function, as assessed by self-reported data on sexuality and general well-being, measurements of nocturnal penile tumescence and rigidity (NPTR) and erectile function elicited by visual erotic stimulation (VES), determined at t1, t2 and t3. RESULTS: During the 3-week interval between injections, there was a sixfold decrease in plasma testosterone level (mean testosterone 35.8, SD 7.8, and 6.0, SD 2.5 nmol/L, at t1 and t3, respectively). At t1, five of the men had a plasma testosterone level above the upper normal limit (> 35 nmol/L) and at t2 and t3, testosterone levels were below the reference range (< 10 nmol/L) in three and six men, respectively. Oestradiol (E2) levels showed the same pattern: at t1 the mean (SD) E2 level was 0.17 (0.07) nmol/L and at t3 0.07 (0.01) nmol/L. In contrast to follicle-stimulating hormone, luteinizing hormone (LH) mirrored the decline in plasma testosterone after injection, with the lowest levels at t1 and the highest at t3. Other hormone levels remained unchanged. Three patients reported loss of libido, decreased arousal, erectile dysfunction, fatigue and mood depression. However, neither the arousal nor the erectile problems could be verified by VES. There was no relationship between plasma testosterone levels, the reported sexual dysfunctions and the results of NPTR and VES measurements. Although unrelated to a specific testosterone level, three patients reported increased irritability, excessive sweating, hot flushes and heat intolerance at the end of the injection interval. These adverse effects of declining plasma testosterone were related to loss of libido and other sexual problems. CONCLUSION: In most patients castrated for bilateral testicular cancer and receiving intramuscular injections with testosterone, plasma testosterone levels were outside the normal range. After injection, there was a rapid decline of plasma testosterone to levels below the lower normal limit. With the exception of oestradiol, sex-hormone levels were not correlated to testosterone levels. Sexual functioning was not affected by the fluctuations of plasma testosterone level. However, at the end of the injection interval, adverse psychological and physical effects had a significant impact on libido and arousal.

目的：両側精巣がんに対して精巣摘除術を受けた患者において、テストステロンの筋肉内注射が性ホルモン値、性機能、全般的な健康感に及ぼす影響を検討すること。
対象と方法：対象は、両側精巣がんに対して精巣摘除術を受けた男性7例（年齢中央値38歳、範囲25〜46歳）。患者はテストステロン（Sustanon）を3週間ごとに筋注され、血液検体を3時点（注射1日後：t1、次回注射までの中間：t2、注射直前：t3）で採取した。血漿ホルモン値は、性と全般的な健康に関する自己申告、夜間陰茎勃起・硬度の測定（NPTR）、視覚的性刺激（VES）による勃起機能と関連づけて評価した。
結果：注射間隔の3週間で血漿テストステロンは約6倍低下した（t1とt3の平均値はそれぞれ35.8±7.8、6.0±2.5nmol/L）。t1では5例が正常上限（35nmol/L）を超えており、t2とt3ではそれぞれ3例と6例が基準範囲（10nmol/L未満）を下回った。エストラジオール（E2）も同様の推移を示した。卵胞刺激ホルモンとは異なり、黄体形成ホルモン（LH）はテストステロンの低下を反映し、t1で最低、t3で最高となった。その他のホルモン値は変化しなかった。3例が性欲低下、性的興奮の減退、勃起障害、疲労、気分の落ち込みを訴えた。しかし、興奮と勃起の問題はVESでは確認されなかった。血漿テストステロン値、報告された性機能障害、NPTRおよびVESの結果の間に関連は認めなかった。さらに3例が注射間隔の終わりに、易怒性、発汗過多、ほてり、熱不耐性の増加を報告した。これらの有害事象は、特定のテストステロン値とは無関係であったが、テストステロン低下に伴う性欲低下やその他の性機能障害と関連していた。
結論：両側精巣がんで去勢され、テストステロンの筋注を受けた大半の患者では、血漿テストステロン値が正常範囲外であった。注射後には血漿テストステロンが正常下限を下回るまで急速に低下した。エストラジオールを除き、性ホルモン値はテストステロン値と相関しなかった。性機能は血漿テストステロン値の変動による影響を受けなかった。しかし、注射間隔の終わりには、心理的・身体的な有害影響が性欲と興奮に有意に影響した。
